ownRead.statement:
## E21 — Pattern formation in a Swift-Hohenberg equation with spatially periodic coefficients

**theory / mathematical derivation · partial bridge · claims C6.**

**Reported result:** A slow-amplitude description is justified for a specified pattern-forming equation near onset, under stated spectral and coefficient assumptions.

**Already supplied:** The equation, spatially periodic coefficients and near-instability regime are specified.

**Limit of the RRG connection:** A controlled change of scale in description is not an unlimited sequence of new physical levels. The environmental heterogeneity is given, not derived from the emerging pattern.

**Source:** Kamphuis & Chirilus-Bruckner (2026), *Physica D 493, 135239*. [DOI: 10.1016/j.physd.2026.135239](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.physd.2026.135239).

**Verification coverage:** Publisher HTML, including assumptions and approximation result. Not an independent formal proof check. Checked 2026-10-02. 2026 paper available by this audit; September 2026 issue.
